ravi_cs: Drafting a short onboard-workshop runbook for CSMs. Goal: 20min customer enablement session + quick ops checklist (prefill tuning, demo fallback, VOC capture). Pasteable and tiny.

megan_se: love it. please add a tiny auto-tune snippet for prefill TTL based on recent idle distribution. helps avoid manual churn.

ravi_cs: dropping a minimal TTL autotune pseudocode (CS can send to SE/SRE):

```
# prefill-ttl auto-tune (pseudocode)
idle_med = query("histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(idle_seconds_bucket[1h])) by (le))")
if idle_med > 60:
  ttl = 20  # short interactive sessions
elif idle_med > 30:
  ttl = 45
else:
  ttl = 90
apply_prefill_ttl(tenant, ttl)
```

hayden_sre: nice. SRE note: escalation criteria -> page SRE + mark RenewalWatch when >=3 activation-blocking flows in 21d OR 3 cluster errors in 48h. add quick mitigations: bump prefill pool, enable safe-fallback, temporarily add batch workers.

claire_pm: for VOC: add a 1-paragraph structured pulse to send at day 3 and day 14: 3 Likert items (latency, accuracy, reliability) + one open text for blocked flows + ask for top 2 mission-critical flows. we will use responses to prioritize prefill targets.

ravi_cs: workshop agenda (pasteable):
- 5m intros + objectives
- 10m live demo (verify streaming + prefill behavior)
- 5m config walkthrough (prefill TTL, batching knobs, max_tokens guards)
- 5m collect 3 sample prompts and VOC answers

and a short pasteable client fallback snippet we can send customers:

```
# client fallback (simple, pasteable)
try:
  stream.connect(prompt)
except StreamUnavailable:
  if prefill.ready_for(prompt):
    prefill.apply(prompt)
  else:
    sync.request(prompt, max_tokens=200)
```
